cues.label: battle dusk: crackling fires, smoke, distant drums and shouting of the enemy camp; tense low percussion building
cannon 1 fires: deep boom + whoosh of the ball
impact on plain mortar: hard crack, brittle stone splitting (crackle runs outward)
impact + long tearing crackle racing along the whole row of courses
the general's big belly laugh on top (non-verbal, under the narration)
cut to the top of the wall
impact below the parapet: heavy thud, the whole wall shudders (rumble), general's laugh hiccups
the section collapses: grinding rumble, bricks tumbling, a huge dusty whoomph
the general drops with a long cartoon 'wheee' slide-whistle down, still laughing
helmet pops off: a 'boing' + whirring spin, then a tin clank as it lands
he slides down the rubble on his backside: bumpy scraping slide, dust puffs
he sits in the dust, coughs once and keeps laughing; a playful button-ending sting on the last word 'ข้างบน'
